original: ミブナの里には\n変わった習慣がありますのね
traducao: Mibuna Village has some quite unusual\ncustoms, doesn't it?

original: まあ、正月や盆なんかは確かに\n他の地域にはない風習みたいだね
traducao: Well, New Year's and Obon are certainly\ncustoms you don't see elsewhere.

original: ショウガツ……ボン？\n何の話をしているの
traducao: New Year's... Obon?\nWhat are you talking about?

original: ああ
traducao: Yeah.

original: 正月と盆の話をしてたんだ……ええ〜っと\nミブナの里に伝わる\nちょっと変わった恒例行事でさ
traducao: We were talking New Year's and Obon...\nErr... they're unusual age-old traditions\npassed down in Mibuna Village.

original: 高齢行事……
traducao: Old-age traditions...?

original: それは、何をするものなの？
traducao: What do you do for those?

original: モチという、白くて伸びる食べ物を\nみんなで食べたり
traducao: Everyone eats a white, stretchy food\ncalled mochi together,

original: ハネツキという遊びをして\n新しい年をお祝いするのだそうですわ
traducao: and they play a game called hanetsuki\nto celebrate the new year, I hear.

original: モチ……ハネツキ？
traducao: Mochi... Hanetsuki?

original: モチは気を付けないと、喉に詰まらせて\n亡くなる方もいるそうですの
traducao: If one isn't careful, some choke on mochi\nand pass away, apparently.

original: まあ、たま〜に……だけどね
traducao: Well, very rarely... but yeah.

original: ハネツキは？
traducao: And hanetsuki?

original: 互いに打ち合って、負けた方が\nスミという黒い液体で\n顔にバツを書かれる遊びだそうですわ
traducao: You hit it back and forth, and the loser\nhas an X drawn on their face\nwith a black liquid called sumi ink.

original: 撃ち合って……罰を……？
traducao: Shoot each other... and punishment...?

original: まあ、その習慣も段々廃れて……
traducao: Well, that custom's dying out anyway...

original: って、ソフィ？　\nどこに行くんだい？
traducao: Wait, Sophie!?\nWhere are you going?

original: 何だか表情が暗かったですわね……
traducao: Her expression seemed rather grim...

original: ジーニアス。\n教科書、ありがとう
traducao: Genis.\nThanks for the textbook.

original: ううん。\nこれくらい、いつでも言ってよ
traducao: Don't mention it.\nAsk anytime for something like this.

original: ……ねこ
traducao: ...A cat.

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: ねこ……可愛いね。\n５６ページの、隅の……
traducao: The cat... is cute.\nIn the corner of page 56...

original: ねこ？
traducao: A cat?

original: まさか……
traducao: Could it be...

original: あーっ！　\nゼロスの奴、\nまたボクの教科書に落書きして！！
traducao: Aargh!\nThat Zelos doodled in\nmy textbook again!!

original: もう許さないぞ！\n姉さんに言い付けてやる
traducao: I won't forgive him!\nI'm going to tell my sister!

original: ねこ……消しちゃうの？
traducao: Are you going to... erase the cat?

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: う……消さないよ。\nモチロン
traducao: Er... I won't erase it.\nOf course.

original: 良かった。\n消えちゃったら、ねこ、かわいそう
traducao: I'm glad.\nPoor cat, if it got erased.

original: ソフィって……、\n優しいんだね……
traducao: Sophie, you're...\nreally kind, aren't you...?

original: （そういうところも\n　ちょっとプレセアに\n　似てるなぁ……）
traducao: (That side of her...\n reminds me a bit\n of Presea too...)

original: お空の光……綺麗
traducao: The sky's light... is pretty.

original: そうね。\n綺麗ね
traducao: Yes.\nIt is pretty.

original: ねえ、セルシウス。\nどうして、お日様の光は\nあんなに綺麗なんだろう？
traducao: Hey, Celsius.\nWhy is the sunlight\nso beautiful, I wonder?

original: それは、世界樹が\nこの世界を愛しているからよ
traducao: That is because the World Tree\nloves this world.
...Love?

original: 目の前の綺麗なものを、誰かに見せたい。\nソフィは、そう思った事はない？
traducao: Seeing something pretty and sharing it...\nHave you never felt that, Sophie?

original: ある。\nアスベルと、シェリアに。\n喜んで欲しいから
traducao: I have.\nTo Asbel and Cheria.\nBecause I want them to be happy.

original: 同じ事なのよ
traducao: It is the same thing.

original: 世界樹は、あなた達ヒトに\n綺麗なものを見せたかったのだと思うの
traducao: I believe the World Tree wanted to show\nsuch beautiful things to you humans.

original: 世界樹も、ヒトに喜んで欲しかったの？
traducao: The World Tree wanted humans to be happy?

original: ええ。\n喜びを知ったヒトは、誰かに\nその喜びをわけたくなる……
traducao: Yes.\nHumans who know joy want to share\nthat joy with someone else...

original: その思いの連鎖が\n優しさを育み、幸福を生んで\nやがて、世界に平和を紡ぐの
traducao: That chain of feelings fosters kindness,\nbrings forth happiness, and eventually\nweaves peace for the world.

original: そうして編まれた未来の一つに\nわたし達がいるのよ
traducao: And we are one of the futures\nwoven from that.

original: ……世界樹って、すごいんだね
traducao: ...The World Tree is amazing.

original: アスベルにも、教えてあげなきゃ
traducao: I must tell Asbel too.

original: バリバリ……。\nあ〜ら、少年、随分かわいいもの食べてるのね。\nバリバリ……
traducao: *crunch* *munch*...\nMy, my, junior, eating something so cute!\n*crunch* *crunch*...

original: おい、部屋に入る時は\nノックぐらいしろ！！
traducao: Hey, at least knock\nwhen you enter someone's room!!

original: 隠したって、ダメダメ〜。\n少年のプリン、もう見えちゃったんだから
traducao: No use hiding it~\nI already saw your pudding, junior!

original: ……僕が僕の部屋で、何を食べても\nお前に関係ないだろう
traducao: ...Whatever I eat in my own room\nis none of your business.

original: ん、確かに関係ないね
traducao: Hmm, certainly none of my business.

original: プリン……。\n美味しそう……
traducao: Pudding...\nIt looks delicious...

original: ……何だ。\nそんな目で見ても、これは僕のだ
traducao: ...What?\nLook all you want, this is mine.

original: おい、何をする！
traducao: Hey, what are you doing!?

original: じゃ〜ん、特製せんべいプリンパフェ∀\nどうどう？　\n美味しそうじゃない？
traducao: Ta-da! Special senbei pudding parfait!\nWell, well?\nDoesn't it look delicious?

original: 貴様……覚悟はいいな？
traducao: You... are you prepared to die?

original: ちょっとちょっと！\nこんなにサービスしてあげたんだから\n少しくらい食べなさいよ！
traducao: Hold on, hold on!\nAfter I gave you such a nice treat,\nat least have a bite!

original: いらん！
traducao: No way!

original: 食べかけのせんべいが\n刺さったプリンなど、\n誰が食べるか！
traducao: Who in their right mind would eat\npudding with a half-eaten\nrice cracker stuck in it!?

original: 好き嫌いダメ……。\n残すならわたしが食べる
traducao: Being picky is bad...\nIf you leave it, I'll eat it.

original: うん、美味しいよ。\nリオンも食べてみて
traducao: Mm, it's yummy.\nLeon, you should try some too.

original: 嘘だ！　\n僕は絶対に食べないぞ！
traducao: Liar!\nThere is no way I'm eating that!

original: ソフィちゃんが、食べてくれた〜〜〜∀
traducao: Sophie-chan actually ate it~~~!

original: プリン、美味しい……
traducao: The pudding is delicious...

original: シェリア、今日はカニタマにするって\n約束したのに……
traducao: Cheria promised we'd have Crablette\ntoday, and yet...

original: そう怒るなよ、ソフィ
traducao: Don't be so mad, Sophie.

original: 出てくるんだ、いい子だから
traducao: Come on out, like a good girl.

original: やだ。\nここにいる
traducao: No.\nI'm staying here.

original: ソフィ……。\nシェリアだって、材料が揃っていれば\nちゃんとカニタマを作っていたさ
traducao: Sophie...\nIf Cheria had all the ingredients,\nshe would have made the Crablette.

original: ……じゃあ、どうして材料、\n買い忘れてたの
traducao: ...Then why did she forget\nto buy the ingredients?

original: う……それは……
traducao: Ugh... Well, that's...

original: 忘れない様に、今度から\nカニタマの日というのを作っては\nどうでしょうか
traducao: To prevent forgetting, why don't we\nestablish a Crablette Day\nfrom now on?

original: カニタマの日……！！
traducao: Crablette Day...!!

original: その日は、みんなでカニタマを食べるという\n特別な日にするんです。\nそうすれば、買い出しも忘れません
traducao: It will be a special day where\neveryone eats Crablette together.\nThat way, no one will forget groceries.

original: なるほどな……。\nカニタマの日か。\nだけど……
traducao: I see...\nA Crablette Day, huh.\nHowever...

original: 作る。\n今日はカニタマの日にする
traducao: We'll do it.\nToday will be Crablette Day.

original: 今日はダメです。\n準備が間に合いません。\n明日にしてはどうでしょうか
traducao: Today will not do.\nWe cannot prepare in time.\nWhy not make it tomorrow?

original: わかった。\nじゃあ明日は、カニタマの日
traducao: Okay.\nThen tomorrow is Crablette Day.

original: おいおい……勝手に決めていいのか？
traducao: Hold on... Can you just decide that?

original: 問題ないと思います
traducao: I believe there is no problem.

original: カニタマ……じゅる……
traducao: Crablette... *drool*...
